tools.purpose: Local Wispr Flow and Apple Notes reads, explicit exports, guarded Apple changes, and one-way mirroring.
tools.freshness: Discovery batches fresh native metadata. Body/all search reads current bodies without an index; doctor reports build identity and capabilities. Wispr needs no sync.
tools.safety: Wispr is read-only. Apple writes require stable IDs and exact intent. Create/update/append/replace/move/delete resolve real previews and need --if-match HASH --apply --yes; stale writes fail before dispatch and applied edits are read back. Prefer append or exact replace over whole-body replacement. Attachment and ambiguous native list/table body edits fail closed. Native checklist state, history and atomic CAS are unavailable. Mirrors are one-way and never delete Notes.

command.purpose: Local Wispr Flow and Apple Notes reads, explicit exports, guarded Apple changes, and one-way mirroring; use the canonical skill and detailed routing safeguards.
